_comment: One show's roster. ASK the user for every choice marked (ask) -- never assume a camera combination. Paths are absolute or relative to the show folder ($VIVECUT_SHOW_ROOT).

anchor._camera: (ask) a camera with ONE FILE PER SONG covering every song; its timeline is the shared clock
anchor._clock_fix_s: seconds to ADD to its creation_time to get real UTC (compare against a phone with network time)
anchor._audio: 'soundtrack' = mixed by build_soundtrack.py from the user's preferred audio sources; 'self' = the anchor's own audio (e.g. a camcorder on the board feed)

director._priority: (ask) preferred VIDEO sources, in order; cameras not listed fill in by score
director._dwell: (ask) shots in a row before a forced look at another camera, for variety (default 2)
director._crowd: (ask) which camera sees the dance floor, if any; null to never cut to the crowd. min_dancing = 10 s mean of people dancing; pick ~ the 97th percentile of floor_energy.py's output so only real peaks count
director._avoid_shots: (ask) performer framing preference, e.g. fewer shots from behind: JSON {clip_basename: [[start_s, end_s], ...]}

soundtrack._priority: (ask) preferred AUDIO sources, in order -- often NOT the same as the video preference
soundtrack._bed: (ask) the camera that fills every gap (recorded every song)

floor._cam_b: dance-floor rectangles in frame fractions, read off a whole-show heatmap of people's feet
